over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Blackhawk Network Holdings, Inc. realized record, ~3-5-year horizon after closing

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the company was taken private and
> deregistered, there is no post-closing public 10-K; the realized record is traced
> through the company's own disclosures and reputable press. This sub-dossier contains
> no information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- Following completion of the merger, the Company requested that NASDAQ suspend
  trading of, and withdraw from listing, its common stock, and file a Form 25 to
  remove the stock from listing and registration under Section 12(b) of the Exchange
  Act. [SRC: SEC accession 0001140361-18-028701, Form 8-K]
- The Company filed a Form 15-12B on 2018-06-25 to terminate registration of its
  common stock under the Exchange Act. [SRC: SEC accession 0001140361-18-029766, Form 15-12B]
- No Form 10-K or other annual/periodic report has been filed on EDGAR by CIK
  0001411488 (Blackhawk Network Holdings, Inc.) since the FY2017 Form 10-K/A filed
  2018-04-27, and the registrant's EDGAR filing history since June 2018 shows no
  10-K, 10-Q, or 20-F entries. [SRC: SEC accession 0001140361-18-029766, Form 15-12B]
- A search of EDGAR company records for related entity names ("BHN Holdings," "BHN
  Intermediate Holdings," "BHN Merger Sub") returns no separate SEC registrant that
  has filed periodic annual reports disclosing the acquired business's financial
  results. [UNVERIFIED]
- Consequently, no audited public financial statements exist for the company for the
  ~2021-2023 outcome window, and the realized-record facts below rely on reputable
  press rather than primary SEC filings. [SRC: SEC accession 0001140361-18-029766, Form 15-12B]

## Realized business record under private ownership (press-sourced, within window)
- In a January 11, 2022 opinion piece (within the ~3-5-year window), Talbott Roche is
  described as continuing to serve as president and CEO of Blackhawk Network, and is
  quoted discussing the company's payments-technology business and its direction
  following the accelerated digital adoption of 2021. [SRC: https://www.pymnts.com/opinion/2022/blackhawk-network-2021-was-the-year-of-the-consumer/]
- The January 2022 piece contains no revenue, headcount, or other quantified
  operating-scale figures for the company. [SRC: https://www.pymnts.com/opinion/2022/blackhawk-network-2021-was-the-year-of-the-consumer/]

## Items noted but outside the fixed outcome window
- Reputable press reported in April 2025 (beyond the ~3-5-year window) that Silver
  Lake and P2 Capital Partners, the company's owners since the 2018 transaction, were
  evaluating strategic options including a full sale or an initial public offering of
  the company, at a reported potential valuation exceeding $5 billion, with the
  company still described as privately held at that date and no divestiture having
  occurred. [SRC: https://pe-insights.com/silver-lake-and-p2-capital-weigh-5bn-sale-or-ipo-of-blackhawk-network-amid-payments-sector-ma-surge/]
- This is outside the fixed ~2021-2023 outcome window and is noted only as later
  context; it is not treated as an in-window outcome fact. [SRC: https://pe-insights.com/silver-lake-and-p2-capital-weigh-5bn-sale-or-ipo-of-blackhawk-network-amid-payments-sector-ma-surge/]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the company was taken private and deregistered in June 2018, there is no
  public audited outcome record for the ~2021-2023 window; the only traceable
  in-window fact is a January 2022 press item confirming the company's pre-merger
  chief executive continued to lead the business and that it continued operating in
  the payments-technology sector, with no financial or operational scale figures
  disclosed. [SRC: https://www.pymnts.com/opinion/2022/blackhawk-network-2021-was-the-year-of-the-consumer/]
- No public record within the fixed window documents a divestiture, bankruptcy,
  dissolution, or other change-of-control event for the company; a later (2025,
  outside the window) press report indicates the same private owners still held the
  company and were considering exit options at that time. [SRC: https://pe-insights.com/silver-lake-and-p2-capital-weigh-5bn-sale-or-ipo-of-blackhawk-network-amid-payments-sector-ma-surge/]

[SLICE END]
